title: A log entry reads Unassigned for a rep who no longer exists
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create two active staff members for this test at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A and sales rep B.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Create a first work order for this test for that customer, open and not invoiced, whose "Sales Representative - Labor" field reads sales rep A and whose "Sales Representative - Parts" field holds a staff member made for this test whose staff record no longer exists.
  • Create a second work order for this test for that customer, open and not invoiced, whose one "Sales Representative" field holds a staff member made for this test in another organization.
  • Open the first work order in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Set "Sales Representative - Labor" to sales rep B.
  2. Open the work order's menu.
  3. Click Audit Log.
  4. Close the log.
  5. Open the second work order.
  6. Set its Sales Representative to sales rep A.
  7. Open the work order's menu.
  8. Click Audit Log.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Labor reads sales rep B.

Step 2:

  • The work order's menu opens.

Step 3:

  • The newest entry reads "Sales Representative: Unassigned (Parts) · [sales rep A's name] (Labor) → Unassigned (Parts) · [sales rep B's name] (Labor)".
  • The Parts side never reads a bare "(Inactive)".

Step 4:

  • The log closes.

Step 5:

  • The second work order opens.

Step 6:

  • The field reads sales rep A.

Step 7:

  • The work order's menu opens.

Step 8:

  • The newest entry reads "Sales Representative: Unassigned → [sales rep A's name]".

A manual tester cannot set up this case: a staff record stops existing, or sits in another organization, only through a data repair. The developers check it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11271 (Story 7, Record representative changes in the work order log)

  • S7-R6: “A side whose staff member no longer exists, or belongs to another organization, reads "Unassigned" in the entry, as on the card (S1-E3).”
  • S7-R2: “The entry shows "Sales Representative: {before} → {after}". A work order that is not split reads the one name, or "Unassigned".”
  • S7-R3: “A split work order reads both sides, Parts first: "Devon Whitfield (Parts) · Elliot Brennan (Labor)". An empty side reads "Unassigned", for example "Devon Whitfield (Parts) · Unassigned (Labor)".”
  • Story 6 context note (S6-N1, S1-E3, S7-R6): “* Context note (S6-N1, S1-E3, S7-R6): a staff record stops existing only through a data repair; ShopView offers no way to delete one. Developers check these cases; manual QA cannot set them up.”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 5: “5. Card: (a) "Unassigned". Audit Log: (d) "Unassigned". Same as the printout.”
  • Chris Ward's answer 30: “30. (b) Only through a data repair, so the developers check it, not a manual tester.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
